messages:
jess: Heads-up: we're soft-opening a small dedicated B320 pool in singapore-sgp1 next Tue 2026-02-10 03:00 UTC. Target: low-cost inference for short-context models.

omar: Nice! Is this gated? who gets access first?

jess: Gated rollout: 12h internal canary -> selected beta customers -> general soft-open. Canaries limited to infra/SE + 5 partner accounts.

cheng: Reservation rules? limits?

jess: Default reservation cap = 4 units per org. Private tenants can petition for higher quotas via capacity-requests with workload/throughput numbers. New policy: burst reservations in SGP pocket window (02:00-07:00 UTC) are rate-limited to 1.5x per-org baseline to avoid global bleed.

gwen: Any change to fairshare weighting or preemptible behavior?

jess: Fairshare tweak: B320 pocket reservations get weight=0.7 during pocket window. Preemptible still available but disabled for first 48h on the pool. Preemption policy unchanged otherwise.

omar: Routing / fallback if SGP is saturated?

jess: Smart routing fallback order: ap-southeast-2 (SYD) -> ap-east-1 (HKG) -> eu-west-1. Fallback only for routes with `allow_fallback:true`. Requests without fallback will queue for up to 20s then fail with capacity error.

cheng: Monitoring / alerts to watch?

jess: Added SGP B320 tile to Console -> Dedicated -> Pools. Dashboards show util, queue_time_p50/p95, OOMs, preempt_count. Alerts: util > 80% for 15m, p95 queue > 25s for 10m, OOM > 0.4% per 1h. Canary-runbook pinned in runbooks channel.

ops-bot: Runbook: https://intranet.redwood.ai/runbooks/sgp-b320-pool (checklist, rollback, scaling commands). Canary script scheduled at 2026-02-10T03:05:00Z.

gwen: Billing model for decks? any promo?

jess: Billing: same dedicated per-hour SKU but billed per-second with 1m min. Promo: first 48h of usage for beta accounts refunded as credit (applied next invoice). Must tag reservations with `env=prod` and `pool:sgp-b320` for credit to apply.

omar: CLI example for reservations?

jess: `redwood reservations create --pool sgp-b320 --count 2 --duration 14d --tags env=prod,pool=sgp-b320`

cheng: Ops: update outage handbook?

jess: Yes please. Add SGP B320 to dedicated outage playbook and include new fallback chain. I'll DM the template.

gwen: GTM comms? Should we proactively notify waitlisted customers?

jess: GTM will get a staged list. We'll notify wave2/wave3 slightly later. Please don't share public docs until we finish canary.

ops-bot: Note: telemetry pipeline will label metrics `region=sgp1` `family=b320`. If you see missing metrics, file a ticket to infra-metrics.

omar: Any perf expectations / limitations?

jess: Perf note: B320 has reduced memory vs larger SKU; recommended max context 4k tokens and batch sizes <=8 for sustained throughput. We'll publish micro-benchmarks in docs after canary.

cheng: Sounds good from infra.

gwen: +1 from GTM, will draft customer copy.

jess: TL;DR timeline: 2026-02-10 03:00 UTC internal canary -> 2026-02-10 15:00 UTC beta wave -> 2026-02-14 general soft-open. Will post canary status after T+12h. :sparkles:

ops-bot: Reminder: run canary allocation at 2026-02-10T03:05:00Z and send notifications to #oncall and #capacity-ops.
